Schnittstelle CustomDrawable

Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
DrawableObject, EmptyGrid, PlotGraph, PlotGrid
public interface CustomDrawable
Defines the contract for objects that can be drawn on a graphics context. Implementing classes must provide custom drawing logic by overriding the configure methods.

  • Methodendetails

    • configureGraphics

      void configureGraphics(Graphics g)
      Customizes the rendering using the basic Graphics context. This method is intended for simple drawing operations that do not require advanced features of Graphics2D.
      Parameter:
      g - the basic graphics context

    • configureGraphics2D

      void configureGraphics2D(Graphics2D g)
      Customizes the rendering using the enhanced Graphics2D context. This method is intended for advanced drawing operations such as shapes, transformations, and anti-aliased rendering.
      Parameter:
      g - the enhanced 2D graphics context
